enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping under extra blankets with the space heater on low against the cold snap
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull extra blankets over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up to chin. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Pull blanket down slightly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth with warm water from the water heater
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on water heater. Wash face with warm water. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe face. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1: toast and instant coffee, checking the news on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take mug. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add instant coffee. Stir. Pick up toast. Eat toast. Drink coffee. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through news. Talk with Member 1. Finish breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in warm layers, packing sketchbook and laptop bag, tidying the desk area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Put on sweater. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up sketchbook. Place in bag. Pick up laptop. Place in bag. Zip bag. Stack papers. Place in drawer. Close drawer. Put pens in holder. Turn off space heater. Pick up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the arts centre by public transport in the cold morning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Take out phone. Check bus app. Put phone away. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Tap card on reader. Walk down aisle. Sit in seat. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk two blocks. Enter arts centre.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator: emails, program scheduling, coordinating with artists and venue staff
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email client. Read new emails. Reply to urgent email. Open calendar. Schedule program event. Call artist. Discuss details. Hang up. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Call venue staff. Confirm booking. Hang up. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Continue emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at a nearby cafe, sketching ideas in a notebook
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Sketch ideas. Pause. Eat more. Sketch more. Drink water. Finish. Pack up. Leave cafe.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon arts administration work: exhibition planning, budget spreadsheets, meetings with the curatorial team
enriched_activities.desc: Return to office. Sit at desk. Open spreadsheet. Enter budget data. Calculate totals. Open exhibition plan document. Edit plan. Attend meeting. Discuss with curatorial team. Take notes. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Send emails. Print documents. File papers.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the arts centre
enriched_activities.desc: Leave building. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a warm dinner together with Member 1, using the induction cooker and oven, listening to a podcast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Turn on induction cooker. Chop vegetables. Add oil to pan. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn on oven. Place dish in oven. Set timer. Play podcast. Stir food. Check oven. Take dish out. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off oven. Plate food. Sit down. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes, loading the dishwasher and wiping down counters together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Clear dishes from table. Carry to sink. Scrape food into bin. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Take sponge. Wet sponge. Wipe counters. Rinse sponge. Wipe table. Talk with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work at the desk: drafting client artwork on the computer with the monitor, desk lamp on and space heater running
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on space heater. Turn on computer. Open illustration software. Open client file. Pick up stylus. Draw lines on tablet. Use keyboard shortcuts. Adjust layers. Zoom in. Zoom out. Save file. Check reference images. Stretch arms. Continue drawing. Save file again.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering with hot water and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to warm. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with a warm drink, watching TV and reviewing tomorrow's freelance briefs on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Find show. Put feet up. Sip warm drink. Pick up phone. Open email. Read freelance briefs. Make notes. Watch TV. Sip drink. Put down phone. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed and winding down before sleep, space heater on low
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on space heater to low. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Get into bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Continue reading. Put book down. Close eyes. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
